fib: ______ is any business that is independently owned and operated, not dominant in its field, and does not engage in any marketing or innovative practices.
small business venture

______ is the key to small business success.
Good management
Good management is the key to small business success.
______ are responsible for debts of the company but their responsibilities for debts are limited to the amount of capital invested in the company.
shareholders
The shareholders are responsible for debts of the company but their responsibilities for debts are limited to the amount of capital invested in the company.

Total Quality Management (TQM)
Total Quality Management
TQM

______ is the process of planning and organising both human and material resources so as to secure the optimum achievement of objectives.
Managing

______ is an estimate of value or worth.
Evaluation
Evaluation is an estimate of value or worth.
______ is a short summary of the information which follows in the business plan.
cover page
The cover page is a short summary of the information which follows in the business plan.
______ is a group of people who come together voluntarily to produce goods or to provide a service.
cooperative
A cooperative is a group of people who come together voluntarily to produce goods or to provide a service.
______ are concerned with overall goals and the general means of achieving them.
Strategies
Strategies are concerned with overall goals and the general means of achieving them.
______ is a partnership with one or more general partners and one or more limited partners.
limited partnership
A limited partnership is a partnership with one or more general partners and one or more limited partners.

Budgeting

______ is a by-product for accomplishing some nobler goals.
Money

______ are the easiest kind of businesses for you to explore in your quest for an interesting career.
Sole proprietorships

______ is a partnership in which all owners share in operating the business and in assuming liability for the business's debts.
general partnership
A general partnership is a partnership in which all owners share in operating the business and in assuming liability for the business's debts.
______ means that an individual person decides to start a business and he/she becomes the sole owner of the business.
Sole proprietorship
Sole proprietorship means that an individual person decides to start a business and he/she becomes the sole owner of the business.
______ is an individual who establishes and manages a business for the principal purpose of profit and growth.
entrepreneur
An entrepreneur is an individual who establishes and manages a business for the principal purpose of profit and growth.
______ is the rate of interest that equates the future streams of income to the present rate.
IRR (Internal Rate of Return)
IRR
IRR (Internal Rate of Return) is the rate of interest that equates the future streams of income to the present rate.
______ are the real meat of the whole business plan.
financial projections
The financial projections are the real meat of the whole business plan.
______ is an owner who invests money in the business but does not have any management responsibility or liability for losses beyond the investment.
limited partner
A limited partner is an owner who invests money in the business but does not have any management responsibility or liability for losses beyond the investment.
______ is a reasoned means of moving towards some selected goals.
plan
A plan is a reasoned means of moving towards some selected goals.
